verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Profiles feature uses version-controlled YAML for declarative entity definitions (implying git-based version history), and the platform exposes an Audit Logs API for tracking changes, but there is no documented UI or workflow for reviewing diffs or rolling back a transformation, pipeline, or tracking plan. missing for 10: explicit rollback/versioning UI for transformations or pipelines, review/diff workflow, and any hands-on evidence of restoring a prior automation state.
